SMT. ASHADEEPIKA W/O RAVIKIRAN DASARI  AGED ABOUT 25 YEARS, OCC: HOUSEWIFE,
 R/O DURGA CAMP, TQ. SINDANOOR,
 DIST.RAICHUR.
... RESPONDENTS (BY SRI. JAMADAR SHAHABUDDIN, HCGP FOR R1  SRI. SHRAVANKUMAR MATH, ADVOCATE FOR R2)

THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED UNDER SECTION 482 OF CR.P.C. PRAYING TO QUASH THE ORDER OF TAKING COGNIZANCE DATED 24.11.2022 IN C.C.NO.5887/2022 (CRIME NO.64/2022) PASSED BY THE ADDITIONAL CIVIL JUDGE AND J.M.F.C. SINDHANUR, FOR THE OFFENCES PUNISHABLE U/SEC. 498A, 323, 354, 504 AND 506 R/W SECTION 34 OF IPC.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
The learned counsel for the petitioner and petitioner are present before the Court.

Sri. 
Shravankumar Math, the learned counsel filed Vakalat for the respondent No.2.
The respondent No.2 is also present before this Court and identified by Sri. Shravankumar Math, the learned counsel.

The respondent No.2 who is the wife of the petitioner herein had filed a complaint against the petitioner alleging the offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 323, 354, 504 and 506 read with Section 34 of IPC, which came to be registered in Crime No.64/2022 of Turvihal Police Station, Dist:
Raichur.
On the basis of the said complaint, after investigation, the Investigating Officer had filed the charge-sheet.
03. The respondent No.2 had also filed a complaint under the provisions of the Domestic Violence Act.
The matter was pending before the Prl. Civil Judge and JMFC, Court at Gangavati in Crl.Misc.No.366/2022.

The petitioner challenging the registration of the FIR against him at Turvihal Police Station, has approached this Court for quashing the said proceedings under Section 482 of Cr.P.C.
04.

Now, both the parties are before this Court stating that with the help of the elders, they have buried their hatred and they want to go their own ways by going for a settlement under which they Ravikiran Dasar And Ors vs The State Of Karnataka And Anr on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33256540/
2 have agreed to file a NC: 2024:KHC-K:2214 Joint Petition for divorce.

sentences.text: They have also settled the matter pertaining to the Domestic Violence Act at Prl. Civil Judge and JMFC, Court at Gangavati.

The petitioner and the respondent No.2 have sworn to affidavits and filed an application under Section 320 read with Section 482 of Cr.P.C. seeking to quash and close the Crime No.64/2022 and C.C.No.5887/2022 which is pending before the Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Court at Sindhanur.

entities.text: Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Court at Sindhanur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 05. This Court is satisfied that the settlement between the parties is in the interest of justice and equity and is in better interest of the children.
The respondent No.2 on a query by this Court submits that she is earning and she would look after the children.
She also submits that the petitioner is parting with 01 acre of land which he possess in favour the wife and the children.
06. In view of the said settlement reached between the parties which appear to be just and proper and in the interest of the parties, the submission is accepted.

Accordingly, the following;
NC: 2024:KHC-K:2214 ORDER I.

The joint application filed by the petitioner and the respondent No.2 is allowed by exercising the power under Section 482 of Cr.P.C.
II.
The petition is allowed.

III. The Crime No.64/2022 of Turvihal Police Station and the proceedings emanating from the said FIR, including C.C.No.5887/2022 which is pending before the Additional Civil Judge and JMFC,
Court at Sindhanur, are hereby quashed.
